description: Source code for sending messages via the BlueBubbles API, including chat creation, message sending with effects, reply threading, and private API handling.

methods.name: blueBubblesPolicy
methods.description: Creates a policy object for private network access based on the allowPrivateNetwork flag.

methods.name: resolveEffectId
methods.description: Maps short effect names to full Apple effect IDs, with normalization and fallback.

methods.name: resolvePrivateApiDecision
methods.description: Determines if private API features can be used based on server status and requested features.

methods.name: parseBlueBubblesMessageResponse
methods.description: Parses the response from BlueBubbles API after sending a message to extract message ID.

methods.name: extractChatGuid
methods.description: Extracts chat GUID from various possible fields in a chat record.

methods.name: extractChatId
methods.description: Extracts chat ID as a number from chat record fields.

methods.name: extractChatIdentifierFromChatGuid
methods.description: Extracts chat identifier component from a chat GUID string.

methods.name: extractParticipantAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves participant addresses from chat record.

methods.name: queryChats
methods.description: Queries chats from BlueBubbles API with pagination.

methods.name: resolveChatGuidForTarget
methods.description: Resolves chat GUID for a given target, creating new chat if necessary.

methods.name: createChatForHandle
methods.description: Creates a new chat for a handle, optionally sending an initial message.

methods.name: createNewChatWithMessage
methods.description: Creates a new chat and sends an initial message, requiring private API.

methods.name: sendMessageBlueBubbles
methods.description: Main function to send a message via BlueBubbles, handling chat resolution, effects, reply threading, and error handling.
